valid.name: module-scope const map with inline function value - pre-built, not rebuilt per call

valid.code: class X { static map = { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
valid.name: static class field map with inline function value - pre-built, not flagged

valid.code: declare function someNamedFunction(): number; const map = { a: someNamedFunction };
valid.name: named function reference (not an inline FunctionExpression) - not flagged
key name "transform" at module scope - not flagged because pre-built, not because of the name

valid.code: function build(items: readonly number[]) { return items.map(function (x) { return x; }); }
valid.name: inline function callback argument, but call site is NOT inside a loop - not flagged
bare array literal holding an inline function, not passed to any call - not flagged

valid.code: function build() { return { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
valid.name: one-shot factory: map rebuilt inside a function body, but the function has no lexical loop position and no evidence of being called per-iteration - NOT flagged (the predecessor's "rebuilt in any function" heuristic flagged this identically to real hot-loop code; call frequency, not mere nesting, is what the measured 2.3x cost requires)

valid.code: class X { m() { const map = { a: function () { return 1; } }; return map; } }
valid.name: map rebuilt inside a method body, no loop - not flagged, same reasoning as the one-shot factory

valid.code: class X { field = { a: function () { return 1; } }; }
valid.name: non-static instance field rebuilds per instantiation, but instantiation is not loop iteration - not flagged

valid.code: function build() { return { transformAsync: function () { return 1; } }; }
valid.name: suggestive key name "transformAsync", no loop anywhere - not flagged; the gate is loop evidence, never the key's name

valid.code: function build(handler = function (x: number) { return x; }) { return handler; }
valid.name: default-parameter inline function closure whose owning function `build` is never called anywhere - not flagged, no evidence of call frequency at all

valid.code: function build(handler = function (x: number) { return x; }) { return handler; } build();
valid.name: default-parameter inline function closure whose owning function IS called, but the call site is not per-iteration - not flagged, call exists but is not proven hot

invalid.code: declare const items: readonly number[]; declare function process(it: number, cb: (x: number) => number): void; for (const it of items) { process(it, function (x) { return x; }); }
invalid.name: inline function callback argument passed directly to a call inside a for-of loop - flagged (the textbook per-iteration-closure-allocation case)

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; declare function process(cb: (x: number) => number): void; while (hasNext()) { process(function (x) { return x; }); }
invalid.name: inline function callback argument inside a while loop - flagged

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; declare function register(entries: readonly [string, (x: number) => number][]): void; while (hasNext()) { register(Object.fromEntries([["a", function (x) { return x; }]])); }
invalid.name: non-literal dispatch-table construction (Object.fromEntries) inside a loop - flagged

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; declare function register(entries: Map<string, (x: number) => number>): void; while (hasNext()) { register(new Map([["a", function (x) { return x; }]])); }
invalid.name: non-literal dispatch-table construction (new Map) inside a loop - flagged

invalid.code: declare const items: readonly number[]; function processItems(): void { items.forEach((item) => { const dispatch = { a: function () { return item; } }; dispatch.a(); }); }
invalid.name: dispatch-map value rebuilt inside an Array.prototype.forEach callback - flagged: migrating onto LoopContext (resolved via CallIdentity, not name-matched) closes the .forEach-shaped bypass a lexical loop-keyword walk would miss

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; function build(cond: boolean) { while (hasNext()) { const map = { a: cond ? function (x: number) { return x; } : function (x: number) { return -x; } }; void map; } } void build;
invalid.name: ternary-branched inline functions as an object value in a map rebuilt every iteration of a real loop - both branches flagged

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; function build(handler = function (x: number) { return x; }) { return handler; } while (hasNext()) { build(); }
invalid.name: default-parameter inline function closure whose owning function's ONLY call site is inside a loop - flagged, call-site reachability proves per-iteration allocation

invalid.code: declare function hasNext(): boolean; function build() { while (hasNext()) { const map = { transformAsync: function () { return 1; } }; void map; } } void build;
invalid.name: suggestive key name "transformAsync" inside a real loop - flagged identically to any other key name, no name-based escape
